title: Influence of Novel MOS Varactors on the Performance of a Fully Integrated UMTS VCO in Standard 0.25-m CMOS Technology
type: Influence of Novel MOS Varactors on the Performance of a Fully Integrated UMTS VCO in Standard 0.25-m CMOS Technology
function_summary: Influence of Novel MOS Varactors on the Performance of a Fully Integrated UMTS VCO in Standard 0.25-m CMOS Technology: A novel MOS varactor design is compared to standard MOS varactors and its influence on the tuning range, phase noise, and pushing of a CMOS voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) for UMTS is presented.
